svg.title: NFC player power and connection drawing
svg.desc: Functional wiring reference for the TC4420CPA and SN74AHCT125N, ESP32, SD, PN532, encoder, LED ring, N20 motor and four-ohm three-watt speaker. A protected VTC5A 1S2P pack feeds a TPS61088 JXL V1.10 set to 5 V. The load switch disconnects both converter input and the GPIO34 battery divider. IP5306 is charger-only on the unswitched protected pack; OUT pins are unused and there is no KEY driver. Named supply nets connect across panels. This is not a verified clone-module schematic or a hardware low-voltage disconnect.
svg.text: NFC Player: Power and Connection Drawing
TC4420CPA + SN74AHCT125N | GPIO numbers, not physical DevKit header positions | 4 ohm / 3 W mono speaker
Functional reference, not an electrically verified module schematic. Confirm breakout supply voltages and exact package pinouts.

g.text: verify JXL startup/inrush and allowable capacitance.
Never join raw B- to system GND around the protection.
Switch cuts boost AND divider input; charger stays connected.
No USB/boost source switching; no EN control.
Sleep is NOT a battery disconnect.
Verify module limits and charge termination.
Only identical net labels connect across panels.
Positive nets NEVER connect directly to LOAD_GND.
1S protection and fuse must suit total pack current.
Use matched, safely assembled cells; never a 2S holder.
VBUS = IP5306 USB-C input pad, not OUT+.
USB present: gate high, GPIO35 reads LOW.
Pull-up is to ESP32 3V3; GPIO35 has no internal pull.
Sense only: it switches no load and does not prove charging.
DIP pins: top view, notch up.

g.title: 220 uF motor rail capacitor: positive to LOAD_5V, negative to LOAD_GND, not motor drain.

g.text: Driver: 100 nF + 1 uF across VDD/GND at its pins.
Motor bulk: 220 uF (+ to LOAD_5V, - to LOAD_GND), NOT drain.
4. LED level shift and amplifier shutdown isolation
Bridge groups above; 100 nF at pins 14/7.
Outputs 8, 11: each open; do not join outputs.
AHCT125, not HC125 or HCT126 wiring.
Amp GAIN is separate from SD.
Confirm SD is not hard-strapped to VIN.
Not raw B-. No battery/5 V directly on GPIO.
1.5 mm2 main buses; 0.5 mm2 load branches.
0.33 mm2 short signal wires with nearby returns.
Rated terminals, strain relief and socketed ICs.
100 nF at ESP32 VIN, plus existing board bypass.
player harness, not just the VIN wire.
Identical net labels connect across panels; differently named nets remain separate unless a wire/component joins them. See PINOUT.md.
Capacitor values joined by + mean parallel parts across the stated supply/return. Keep motor/amp/ring return currents out of ESP32 headers.
Charging input is shown at IP5306 only. Dual-USB operation is unverified. Read WIRING.md and MANUAL_TESTS.md before assembly or probing.
